name: Mvog-Betsi Zoo
description: A zoological garden housing rescued Central African wildlife including gorillas, chimpanzees, and big cats.

name: Monument de la Réunification
description: Iconic monument commemorating the 1961 reunification of French and British Cameroon.

name: Musée National du Cameroun
description: Former presidential palace turned national museum showcasing Cameroon's cultural and political history.

name: Lac Municipal de Yaoundé
description: A recently renovated lakeside park popular for jogging, boating, and weekend relaxation.

name: Marché Central
description: Yaoundé's largest traditional market, selling everything from textiles to fresh produce and crafts.

name: Cathédrale Notre-Dame des Victoires
description: A prominent Catholic cathedral known for its striking architecture in the heart of the city.

name: Mont Fébé
description: A forested hill offering panoramic views over Yaoundé, popular for hiking and sunrise visits.

name: Village Artisanal de Yaoundé
description: A cooperative of artisan workshops selling wood carvings, sculptures, and traditional crafts.

name: Restaurant Le Repère
description: A well-loved spot for traditional Cameroonian dishes like ndolé and grilled fish.

name: Palais des Congrès
description: A large convention center and cultural landmark hosting major national events.

name: Jardin Botanique de Yaoundé
description: A quiet botanical garden with native plant species, ideal for a calm afternoon walk.

name: Hilton Hotel
description: A luxury hotel in Yaoundé offering comfortable rooms, restaurants, conference facilities, a swimming pool, and business services.

name: Star Land Hotel
description: A modern hotel known for its comfortable accommodation, meeting rooms, a restaurant, a fitness center, and excellent customer service.

name: Hôpital Général de Yaoundé
description: One of Cameroon's largest referral hospitals, providing specialized medical care, emergency services, surgery, and advanced diagnostic services.

name: Star-Moul
description: A popular restaurant in Yaoundé serving a variety of Cameroonian and international dishes in a comfortable dining environment.
